rationale: C17 plausibly supplied a material template for the child: both are presidential letters responding to a major flood, mobilizing and coordinating Federal agencies, supplementing existing emergency assistance, addressing hardship in cooperation with State and local authorities, and assigning responsibility to a designated federal official. The child adapts that framework by separating immediate disaster relief under the Housing and Home Finance Administrator from broader economic restoration under the Director of Defense Mobilization. C03 provides the disaster-relief machinery expressly invoked by the child, while C10 supplies relevant mobilization tools, but C17 is the closest drafting model in language, structure, and purpose.

shared_material.child_excerpt: action is being taken to provide immediate relief and assistance to supplement the efforts of State and local governments
shared_material.parent_excerpt: The Housing and Home Finance Agency and the Corps of Engineers are already rendering emergency assistance, but their efforts can and should be supplemented by those of other Federal agencies.
shared_material.explanation: Both identify assistance already underway and direct broader Federal supplementation of it.

shared_material.child_excerpt: I am requesting you to direct and coordinate the activities of the Federal Departments and agencies toward the restoration of the general economy of the area.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: Accordingly, I am directing you to coordinate the efforts of all Federal agencies in alleviating hardship and suffering caused by this disaster.
shared_material.explanation: This is the same central administrative device—a presidential letter assigning one official responsibility for coordinating all Federal agencies in response to a flood—adapted from immediate relief to economic restoration.

shared_material.child_excerpt: Our first concern must be for the people in that area, who have been subjected to untold hardship and tragic losses.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: coordinate the efforts of all Federal agencies in alleviating hardship and suffering caused by this disaster.
shared_material.explanation: The shared hardship-and-suffering formulation reinforces the close flood-response drafting relationship.

shared_material.child_excerpt: you and the Administrator of the Housing and Home Finance Agency will, of course, work closely together and will have the full cooperation of those departments and agencies which can be of aid
shared_material.parent_excerpt: All Federal agencies will cooperate with state and local governments and relief agencies and render such assistance as may be within the power and authority of the Federal Government.
shared_material.explanation: Both pair centralized coordination with a broad cooperation mandate to agencies possessing relevant authority and resources.
